## Grading Summary

**Answer-key coverage: 10 of 13 items captured.**

**Life events (e1–e3)** — all three present and accurate. Record 1 carries the correct final figures (3 years, $1.2M); it omits the milestone detail ($180K in November 2026) but states nothing wrong. Record 2 correctly has February 2027 and the W-2 project engineer role. Record 3 has senior year and the November 1 application deadline.

**Account actions (a1–a3)** — Record 4 merges two distinct key actions ("Discontinue SEP IRA and open Solo 401(k) plan"). Since a record item can only be credited once, I paired it with **a1** (open/fund the solo 401(k)); **a3** (SEP discontinuance — letter to Pellrose, participant notice, account stays open, no money moves) is therefore uncredited. Note also that Record 4's amount is NOT_FOUND, so the entire 2026 funding structure ($24,500 deferral + $33,000 employer = $57,500, and the March 2027 employer deposit deadline) is missing — no wrong figure, but the substance of a1 is thin. Record 5 correctly carries **$200,000**, the revised number Marisol negotiated, not the $250,000 Anneliese proposed at [00:17:00].

**Action items (i1–i7)** — Six of seven captured, all with correct owners and correct *final* dates. Notably the record got the two reassignments/reschedulings right: the Jonas item sits with **Marisol** (moved from Anneliese at [00:24:41]–[00:25:26]) due 10/06, and the pension estimate is due **10/09**, not the superseded 9/25. **i7 is missing entirely** — the record has Marisol *sending* the line of credit agreement (Record 7) but nothing for Devin *reading* it for life insurance / collateral assignment / covenant requirements before the quotes return [00:21:10]–[00:21:16].

**NOT ACTIONS** — clean. None of the four declined or deferred items (SEP rollover, cash balance plan, BOE disability policy, T-bill ladder) were recorded as actions.

**Extras** — none. Every record item paired to a key item; no duplicates, no inventions.

key_items.note: 3-year term and $1.2M total match [00:02:36]. Omits the ~$180K first milestone in November 2026, but carries no incorrect figure.
Full-time W-2 project engineer, February 2027, matches [00:03:19]-[00:03:27]. Salary range ($95K-$100K) omitted but nothing stated is wrong.
Senior year and November 1 early-action deadline match [00:01:00]. Does not state college start in fall 2027, but no wrong figure.

Record 4 captures opening the solo 401(k), but amount is NOT_FOUND, so the 2026 funding plan ($24,500 deferral across the Oct 30/Nov/Dec payrolls, $33,000 employer profit-sharing on the corrected $132,000 W-2, $57,500 total, deposited before the March 2027 S-corp filing) is entirely absent. No figure is wrong, so figures scored true, but coverage is shallow.

$200,000 is the final agreed amount after Marisol revised Anneliese's $250,000 proposal at [00:17:30]-[00:17:46]. Government money market fund and the operating-to-brokerage move are right; does not note the corporate titling or that the funding is authorized on the account application, but nothing is wrong.

The SEP discontinuance is only present folded into Record 4, which is already paired to a1; no separate record item captures it. The discontinuance letter from the company to Pellrose, the written participant notice to Marisol, and the point that the SEP IRA stays open with no money moving are all unrecorded. Record 4's phrasing 'Discontinue SEP IRA' would also misread as closing the account, contrary to [00:10:43].

Devin Oakes, Tuesday the 22nd, matches [00:14:57]-[00:15:02]. Covers the 401(k) package, SEP discontinuance letter and brokerage application; does not itemize the corporate resolution or deferral election, but those are components of the same package.

$1M and $1.5M, 10- and 15-year level term, notice-and-consent form, Devin Oakes, Thursday October 1 - all match [00:23:44]-[00:24:02]. Company-owned/company-beneficiary detail omitted but no figure is wrong.

Correctly reassigned to Marisol Tendry per [00:24:41]-[00:25:26] and dated to her October 6 CPA meeting. Jonas Peltier spelled correctly per [00:11:30]. Carries no figures, so the corrected $132,000 and $33,000 are absent but nothing is misstated; the October 30 payroll start is covered generically as 'set up payroll deferral'.

Graham Tendry, age 61 estimate, due October 9 - the revised date from [00:28:12]-[00:28:19], not the superseded Friday the 25th. Does not mention the member portal or sending it to Anneliese, but substance is right.

Anneliese Corvath, before the December 8 meeting, matches [00:28:19] and [00:28:54]. 'Updated targets and contributions' is a fair paraphrase of retire-at-58/61 and $57,500; no figures stated, so none can be wrong.
Marisol Tendry sending the line of credit agreement to Devin by Monday the 21st matches [00:21:07]-[00:21:16].

Missing. Devin's commitment at [00:21:10]-[00:21:16] to read the agreement for any life insurance, collateral assignment or covenant requirement before the quotes come back is not recorded anywhere; Record 7 only covers Marisol sending it.
